name: Love and Murder at Ghastly Manor
source:
A murder shatters the Ghastly Manor Halloween bash. You’re the first detective on the scene – uncover the killer and maybe a little romance along the way. 

Grill and thrill four suspects: a vampiress, a merman, a devil, and a headless horseman. Who’s guilty, and who’s just dangerously charming?

[From [url=https://cameron-connolly.itch.io/love-and-murder-at-ghastly-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场谋杀破坏了恐怖庄园的万圣节狂欢。你是第一个到达现场的侦探——揭开凶手，也许还会在沿途遇到一些浪漫的事情。

烧烤并刺激四名嫌疑人：吸血鬼、人鱼、魔鬼和无头骑士。谁有罪，谁又危险又迷人？

[来自[url=https://cameron-connolly.itch.io/love-and-murder-at-ghastly-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
